title: XiaoXingEEsStorageFoodEater
description: One‑click eat-all from storage – quickly consume every edible item in your storage network to boost your max health cap efficiently, designed for Spice of Life: Carrot Edition.
body:
由于游玩整合包过程中经常会有生活调味料:胡萝卜版这个模组，玩家可以通过吃食物增加生命值上限，但是大部分人看到一背包乃至一整个终端的食物头都大了，干脆就不吃了，故而制作了这个模组。

模组当前支持AE2.RS.汤姆的简易存储.超越维度.精妙背包的一键吃，其中支持AE2.RS汤姆的简易存储支持无线终端一键吃和终端附近一键吃，精妙背包支持背包在身上吃，超越维度支持随时随地吃。

模组配置有以下可选项目

启用按键V（默认，可改）

AE2.RS.超越维度.精妙背包.汤姆的简易存储的一键吃开关

食物黑名单（默认没有食物在黑名单，需要主动添加）

食用食物后，自动清除身上所有buff

防偷吃，领地食物保护，默认关闭（也就是说如果不开启，可以偷吃）

后续可能会更新并支持其他存储模组
Overview
In modpacks, the Spice of Life: Carrot Edition mod is commonly used to increase max health by eating various foods. However, many players feel daunted when facing a full inventory or even an entire storage system packed with food – and often just skip eating altogether. That's why this mod was created.

Supported Storage Mods
Currently, this mod supports one‑click eating from the following storage systems:

Applied Energistics 2 (AE2)

Refined Storage (RS)

Tom's Simple Storage

Beyond Dimensions (a storage/teleport mod)

Sophisticated Backpacks

For AE2, RS, and Tom's Simple Storage, you can eat wirelessly via their wireless terminals or by standing near the terminal.
For Sophisticated Backpacks, you can eat while the backpack is equipped on your body.
For Beyond Dimensions, you can eat anytime and anywhere, without any location restrictions.

Configurable Options (all disabled by default unless noted)
Activation key: V (default, customizable)

One‑click eat toggle – enable/disable for each supported storage mod individually (AE2, RS, Beyond Dimensions, Sophisticated Backpacks, Tom's Simple Storage)

Food blacklist – empty by default; you must manually add items you wish to exclude

Auto‑clear buffs – automatically removes all status effects from your character after eating

Anti‑theft eating & land claim protection – disabled by default (if left off, other players can eat your food from your storage)

Future Plans
Support for additional storage mods may be added in later updates.
